column2: The First Heresy opened the gates of Hell in 1099. Mankind has been fighting back ever since.
The Iron Sultanate and the Hebrew Knights stand alongside Christian nations against the common Infernal foe.
Not all demons serve the same master. The warlords of Hell are as fractious as the powers of Heaven.
Lilith was the first rebel. She may yet rebel again.
The Marid have sailed corrupted seas since before the First Heresy. Their allegiance to Hell is a choice, not a birthright.
The Unmarked belong to no side. In the end, that may be their greatest strength.

The year is 1905. The First Heresy opened the gates of Hell in 1099. For eight centuries, the armies of the Holy world have held the line against the Infernal advance - barely, at terrible cost, and never with enough. The front is quiet. Something is building in the corrupted zones. The Great Trench War is nine years away. Everything you do before it arrives will determine whether mankind survives it.
